notes: Stone closes Era 0 and opens Era 1 ores.
Copper is mined with stone; the reinforced pick opens iron and gold.
Gold is mined with the reinforced pick; plating is a same-level durability side-grade.
The pack recipe uses iron blocks and stick blocks; both are Era 2-reachable.
The pack recipe uses diamond blocks and stick blocks; diamond is opened by iron.
Raw electrum has enabled smelting and blasting recipes.
Titanium ingots and titanium sticks are both produced from Era 5 titanium.
Uranium is opened by Level 5; tungsten is already available in Era 5.
Level 6 recovers adamantite and lunar desh; refined desh is the Era 7 handle.
